card.name: Digits inside dose numbers
card.fires_on: Digits partway through multi-digit dose numbers, usually just before mg, mg/m2 or mg/kg in dosing text. Also fires weakly on a few words in dosing tables or instructions.

modes.label: Digit inside a dose
modes.description: A middle or leading digit of a multi-digit dose figure before a unit.
modes.example: 260 mg greater than 55 kg to 85 kg 390 mg greater than 85 kg 52<<0>> mg Subcutaneous Maintenance Adult Dosage

modes.label: Digit in a calculated total
modes.description: A digit in a parenthesized total or per-area dose such as mg/m2.
modes.example: 2 weeks and reduce the dose temporarily to 11 mg/m 2 every 8 hours (33 mg/m 2 /day, <<9>>9 mg/m 2 /cycle)

modes.label: Stray words in dosing text
modes.description: Occasional ordinary words in dosing tables or tablet instructions.
modes.example: Niacin extended-release tablets should be taken<< whole>> and should not be broken,crushed
